description.narrative:
Insatsen med Transparencia por Colombia (det lokala kapitlet av Transparency International) syftar till att förbättra kontrollen över den offentliga förvaltningen för att göra den mer transparent, ansvarsfull och inriktad på fredsbyggande och det gemensamma bästa genom att:
förespråka ökad öppenhet, ansvar och jämlikhet i tillgången till offentlig förvaltning,
följa upp den kontroll som utövas av rättsväsendet och oberoende kontrollorgan över den offentliga förvaltningen i korruptionsärenden,
främja medborgarnas tillgång till det offentliga rummet och förespråka effektivare skyddsmekanismer för visselblåsare, särskilt de som är relaterade till kränkningar av de mänskliga rättigheterna, samt
stärka öppenheten och ansvarsskyldigheten vid genomförandet av fredsavtalet.
Insatsen kvalificerar som ett Team Sweden-bidrag, eftersom den är kopplad till verifierade svenska affärsintressen genom samarbeten med Electrolux, SKF, Securitas och AstraZeneca. Tillsammans främjar de företagsintegritet, ansvarsfullt företagande och stärker Team Swedens synlighet i Colombia.

The project support for Transparencia por Colombia (the recognized local chapter of Transparency International) aims at improving control over public administration to make it more transparent, responsible, and oriented towards peacebuilding and the common good, by:
Advocating for increased transparency, responsibility, and equality in the access to public administration.
Monitoring the control exerted by the judicial system and independent control bodies over the public administration in corruption cases.
Fostering the appropriation of the public sphere by the citizenry and advocating for more effective protection mechanisms for whistle-blowers, especially those related to human rights violations.
Strengthening transparency and accountability in the implementation of the Peace Agreement.
This contribution qualifies as a Team Sweden Contribution, as it is linked to verified Swedish business interests through collaboration with Electrolux, SKF, Securitas, and AstraZeneca to promote corporate integrity, responsible business conduct, and visibility of Team Sweden in Colombia.

In terms of results already achieved, the additional funds provided in the previous amendment (UM2021/09816/BOGO-138) made it possible to launch tailor-made programs with four Swedish companiesSKF, Securitas, Electrolux, and AstraZenecafocused on the implementation of good corporate practices. These efforts are now being expanded through the Business Corruption Risk Management Assessment (Medición de Gestión Empresarial de Riesgos de Corrupción), led by TpC, which is helping to shape a structured integrity agenda for each participating company. These developments show the relevance of TpCs engagement with the private sector and the potential to build on this work in the future. The initiative also aligns closely with Swedens broader Reform Agenda and its commitment to promoting responsible business conduct.
According to the latest Conclusion on Performance report (UM2021/09816/BOGO-134) and Sidas ongoing dialogue with the partner, TpC has consistently delivered meaningful results. These include sustained advocacy efforts with oversight institutions, development and promotion of accountability tools such as Cuentas Claras, and citizen empowerment initiatives across the country. The organization has also demonstrated flexibility and capacity to adapt its programming in response to Colombias evolving political and economic context.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
